welcome.title: Welcome to Memorall
welcome.content:
Memorall is a local-first AI workspace. Chat lives on the left, and the workspace tabs beside it are what your agent knows and can do.

Six quick stops, then we come back here so you can start. Escape closes the tour at any point.

welcomeReady.title: A quick tour of the workspace
welcomeReady.content:
Your model is ready, so chat already works. Here is what surrounds it.

Six quick stops through the workspace tabs — each one sharpens what your agent knows and can do. Escape closes the tour at any point.

agentsNavigate.title: Agents — who answers
agentsNavigate.content:
An agent bundles its instructions, the memory it may use, and the tools and skills it can reach into one assistant you can reuse.

Memorall ships with one ready to go; add your own for each kind of work.

Next opens Agents.

documentsNavigate.title: Files — what it reads
documentsNavigate.content:
Upload, write, and preview documents here. Anything you keep becomes context an agent can pull into an answer, and can be turned into memory.

Next opens Files.

knowledgeNavigate.title: Memory — what it remembers
knowledgeNavigate.content:
Memory is the graph Memorall builds from your chats and files: concepts, the links between them, and the memory space each one lives in.

Search it, prune it, and agents reuse it in later conversations.

Next opens Memory.

connectionsNavigate.title: Connections — what it can act on
connectionsNavigate.content:
Connections give an agent hands: Gmail, Slack and hundreds of apps through Composio, an MCP server on your machine, or any endpoint you can reach.

Keys are encrypted with your master passkey and stay on this device.

Next opens Connections.

skillsNavigate.title: Skills — how it works
skillsNavigate.content:
A skill is a short markdown procedure, in the SKILL.md format, that teaches an agent a repeatable job — when it applies and the steps to follow.

Write one, import from GitHub, or drop in a folder, then switch it on per agent.

Next opens Skills.

modelsNavigate.title: Models — what it thinks with
modelsNavigate.content:
Every answer runs on a model. Run one in your browser, connect a local server such as Ollama or LM Studio, or point Memorall at a hosted provider.

Swap it whenever you like — the rest of your setup stays put.

Next opens Models.

startHere.title: Start here
startHere.content:
One choice left and chat comes alive. Three ways in:

• Managed service — sign in, nothing to configure.
• Local models — run on this device, no API cost.
• Your own keys — bring OpenAI, OpenRouter, or another provider.

Pick one on this screen, then send your first message. This tour is always in Settings → Help & Tour.

finishReady.title: You're set
finishReady.content:
That's the whole workspace. Chat is here on the left, and every tab you just saw feeds the agent answering you.

Ask it something, or attach a file and ask about that. This tour is always in Settings → Help & Tour.
